game_title: Fallback: Infinite Loop Trap – Underground River
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the torchbearer must hold off shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before shadow wraiths overload Underground River.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before shadow wraiths overload Underground River. Then check loop_safety and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lantern post from shadow wraiths in Underground River: keep loop_safety above zero until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 4, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
